description:
READ-ONLY production-readiness (UAT) checklist over ssh: Odoo service active,
    HTTP 200 on /web/login, nginx up + TLS listener, `list_db=False` in odoo.conf,
    a backup timer/script present, prod DB has tables, disk headroom - and, unless
    `render_report=False`, whether the box can actually PRODUCE A DOCUMENT: the PDF
    toolchain, the installed FONTS (checked separately, because a renderer with no fonts
    emits blank pages and looks healthy doing it), and a REAL Odoo report rendered to PDF
    with its `%PDF-` header verified. The render rolls its transaction back and writes
    nothing. Returns a pass/warn/fail checklist + an overall verdict.
name: acceptance_check
